title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
slides: Is Apple losing faith in its own AI?
Internal teams reportedly face tighter AI spending caps
Apple still ships AI features to millions of users
Your workplace AI budget may tighten the same way
Audit what your team's AI tools actually deliver
thread_text:
1. Apple's AI Faith Test

Internal teams now face tighter spending caps on AI tools, according to reports. That's a signal worth watching.

2. Budgets Shrink Quietly

Apple still ships AI features to millions, but behind the scenes, spending is being scrutinized. The gap between public launch and private caution is the story.

3. Your Budget Next?

If Apple is capping AI spend, your workplace may follow. The same scrutiny is coming for every team's tool stack.

4. Audit Before Renewal

Don't wait for the cap to hit. Check what your AI tools actually deliver — usage, output quality, time saved. Most teams can't answer.

5. Test One Workflow

Pick your most-used AI tool and track its real output for one week. If it doesn't save time, cut it before finance does.

instagram.caption:
Internal teams at Apple now reportedly have spending caps on the AI tools they use.

The same company shipping AI features to millions of users is tightening budgets behind closed doors.

That gap between public launch and private caution is the real story. 🤔

If Apple is watching its AI spend this closely, your workplace budget review is probably next.

Before finance asks, pick your most-used AI tool and track its actual output for one week — usage, quality, time saved. 📊

If it doesn't clearly save time, cut it yourself. ✂️

Which tool on your stack would survive that test? 👇
